description: Idiomatic Go microservice templates, Gin/Echo HTTP handlers, sync.WaitGroup concurrency patterns, context cancellation, and Go CLI tools.
ai_rules: Always propagate context.Context as the first argument in long-running or network functions for timeout and cancellation control.
Handle errors explicitly and avoid ignoring returned error values (_); wrap contextual information with fmt.Errorf.
Prevent goroutine leaks by ensuring channels are closed or receivers terminate when context is canceled.
